postulates.name: oriented cubic record complex
postulates.statement: The substrate is an oriented three-dimensional cubic cell complex with sites, oriented bonds, oriented plaquettes, and cubes; a cell may own finitely many labeled incidence slots such as the two diagonals of a plaquette; every specified finite region admits one global integer-coordinate chart; adjacent cells exist at every specified position; no bounded container or completed infinite totality is postulated.
postulates.failure_condition: A required physical carrier cannot be represented on a finite cubical cell complex, or an inequivalent substrate architecture is adopted without a successor amendment.

postulates.name: global ordinal clock and temporal existence
postulates.statement: There is one global tick order n in N_0 with first tick zero and no postulated final tick. Every physical record has a birth tick and an expiry tick that is either realized later or remains undefined while it persists. Local clocks are recurrent material processes counted against the global order; a C3 or C4 state permutation is not the global tick itself.
postulates.failure_condition: A complete v3 dynamics requires more than one fundamental time order or a timeless physical record.

postulates.name: finite ontic carrier and ternary manifestation
postulates.statement: Every microscopic cell record belongs to a finite alphabet. The complete selected site record contains one ternary actuality slot, one local C3 layer, and a 384-channel binary Hodge/C4/polarity exclusion bank, so site actuality is a surjective many-to-one readout onto {-1,0,+1}. No real or complex amplitude, phase-space coordinate, flux vector, or latency scalar is ontic.
independent_price: finite alphabet on each cell dimension
postulates.a9_scope: A9 is the exact minimum for one blank plus independent C4 phase and Z2 polarity on relation ownership slots. R1-v2 selects A0=T x C3 x {0,1}^384, A1=A9^2, A2=A9^4, and A3=singleton; the field bank has one exclusion bit per complete Hodge/C4/polarity channel. The selection reopens if a mandatory gate requires another type.
postulates.failure_condition: The required dynamics cannot be represented without an infinite-precision microscopic register or a primitive continuum type.

postulates.name: Moore-bounded local causality
postulates.statement: One tick may depend only on complete records in the closed radius-one cubic neighborhood at the preceding tick. Moore-26 is the maximum site dependency support, not the forced active interaction stencil.
postulates.failure_condition: A controllable physical influence or required microscopic update exceeds the declared one-tick dependency hull.

postulates.name: one state-complete homogeneous transaction law
postulates.tag: [AXIOM -- LAW SELECTION; INSTANTIATED BY SELECTED REFERENCE LAW, v3]
postulates.statement: One complete global update X_{n+1}=Phi(X_n) is built from one finite local rule phi and one explicit conflict-free schedule. The same target-blind rule applies at every location and tick and is covariant under unbroken substrate symmetries. Every seed, controller, context record, or pseudorandom state used by the dynamics is part of X_n. The selected law contains at least one named genuinely many-to-one expiry transition; distinctions not transferred into surviving physical records cease to exist ontically, so reversibility may be sector-local but is not global.
postulates.expiry_map: A uniquely admitted phase-2 Hodge packet is absorbed into its targeted blank SC reserve. Eight normal/hand presentations collapse to the same bound A9 output; phase, polarity, one work token, and the carrier line survive while arrival sign, normal, and hand expire.
postulates.failure_condition: No complete finite local rule and conflict-free schedule can satisfy the v3 carrier, locality, named-expiry, and recovery contracts; the selected law is globally bijective; or an alleged expiry retains the lost distinctions in an undeclared carrier.

closure_contract.status: [DEFINITION / ADMISSIBILITY RULE -- not an additional physical postulate]
closure_contract.statement: The exhaustively declared primitive tuple is the complete v3 ontology. Every continuous, probabilistic, geometric, or sector-specific physical object must be a defined finite-resolution readout, history functional, or controlled completion of finite Phi histories with a stated error and stability contract.
closure_contract.reason_not_postulate: The rule adds no carrier, state, relation, or dynamics. It makes explicit the semantic consequence of declaring the primitive tuple exhaustive and prevents unlisted downstream primitives from being relabeled as emergence.
required_derived_targets: physical preparation measure and event probabilities
closure_contract.failure_condition: A claimed v3 sector requires an independently primitive field, action, measure, selector, coupling, metric, or particle catalog.
